"""Generate/check schema types only from the owned MP-05.a fixture; no remote inputs."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("bootstrap", ROOT / "scripts/test-db-bootstrap.py")
h = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(h)
META_IMAGE = "public.ecr.aws/supabase/postgres-meta:v0.98.0"
DESTINATION = ROOT / "src/lib/types/database.ts"
EVIDENCE = ROOT / "docs/state/evidence"
INVENTORY_SQL = ROOT / "tests/integration/db/schema-inventory.sql"


def generate_one(db_id, workdir, password, report, image_id, cycle):
    name = report["project_id"] + f"-types-{cycle}"
    cidfile = workdir / f"types-{cycle}.id"
    env = {"PG_META_DB_URL": f"postgresql://postgres:{password}@127.0.0.1:5432/postgres?sslmode=disable",
           "PG_CONN_TIMEOUT_SECS": "15", "PG_QUERY_TIMEOUT_SECS": "15", "PG_META_GENERATE_TYPES": "typescript",
           "PG_META_GENERATE_TYPES_INCLUDED_SCHEMAS": "public",
           "PG_META_GENERATE_TYPES_DETECT_ONE_TO_ONE_RELATIONSHIPS": "true"}
    try:
        h.run(h.DOCKER + ["create", "--name", name, "--label", f"{h.LABEL}.types={name}",
              "--cidfile", str(cidfile), "--network", f"container:{db_id}",
              *[arg for key in env for arg in ("-e", key)], image_id, "node", "dist/server/server.js"],
              cwd=workdir, timeout=30, extra_env=env)
        cid = cidfile.read_text().strip()
        info = h.inspect_container(cid, workdir)
        if (not re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", cid) or info["id"] != cid or info["name"] != "/" + name
                or info["image"] != image_id or info["labels"].get(h.LABEL + ".types") != name
                or info["network"] != f"container:{db_id}" or info["bindings"] or info["mounts"]):
            h.fail("generator container identity/isolation differs from owned plan")
        result = subprocess.run(h.DOCKER + ["start", "-a", cid], cwd=workdir, env=h.LOCAL_ENV,
                                text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", capture_output=True, timeout=60)
        if result.returncode:
            h.fail("type generator failed: " + h.safe_error((result.stderr + result.stdout).replace(password, "[redacted]")))
        generated = result.stdout.replace("\r\n", "\n").strip() + "\n"
        if (not generated.startswith("export type Json =") or "export type Database =" not in generated
                or re.search(r"\bany\b|PLACEHOLDER|Record<string,", generated) or password in generated):
            h.fail("type generator did not emit a valid non-placeholder TypeScript artifact")
        return generated
    finally:
        try:
            if not h.owned(workdir, report["project_id"]):
                h.fail("generator cleanup workdir ownership differs")
            ids = h.docker(["ps", "-aq", "--no-trunc", "--filter", f"label={h.LABEL}.types={name}"], cwd=workdir, timeout=20).split()
            captured = cidfile.read_text().strip() if cidfile.is_file() else ""
            if (ids or captured) and (not re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", captured) or ids != [captured]):
                h.fail("generator cleanup requires matching captured ID; resources retained")
            for cid in ids:
                info = h.inspect_container(cid, workdir)
                if info["id"] != cid or info["name"] != "/" + name or info["image"] != image_id or info["labels"].get(h.LABEL + ".types") != name:
                    h.fail("generator cleanup ownership differs; resources retained")
                h.docker(["rm", "-f", "-v", cid], cwd=workdir, timeout=30)
            if h.docker(["ps", "-aq", "--filter", f"label={h.LABEL}.types={name}"], cwd=workdir, timeout=20).strip():
                h.fail("generator remains after cleanup")
        except (RuntimeError, OSError, ValueError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
            # The parent must not erase generator ownership evidence on cleanup failure.
            (workdir / "retain-resources").write_text("generator cleanup needs inspection\n")
            raise


def finish_artifact(text, mode):
    if mode == "--check":
        if DESTINATION.read_bytes() != text.encode("utf-8"):
            h.fail("checked-in database types differ from the regenerated schema; run db:types")
    else:
        temporary = DESTINATION.with_suffix(".ts.pending")
        with temporary.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as output:
            output.write(text)
        temporary.replace(DESTINATION)


def main(*, evidence_prefix="MP-05b"):
    if not re.fullmatch(r"MP-\d{2}[a-z](?:[1-9]\d*)?", evidence_prefix):
        h.fail("invalid internal evidence prefix")
    if sys.argv[1:] not in (["--write"], ["--check"]):
        h.fail("choose --write or --check; external URLs/project refs are not accepted")
    mode = sys.argv[1]
    report = {"status": "failed", "mode": mode, "scope": "public schema types and catalog only; no auth/RLS acceptance"}
    original_hash = hashlib.sha256(DESTINATION.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    try:
        h.require_local_docker(ROOT)
        image_id = h.docker(["image", "inspect", "--format", "{{.Id}}", META_IMAGE], cwd=ROOT, timeout=20).strip()
        outputs, inventories = [], []

        def after_reset(db_id, workdir, password, fixture_report):
            outputs.append(generate_one(db_id, workdir, password, fixture_report, image_id, len(outputs) + 1))
            inventories.append(json.loads(h.psql(db_id, workdir, INVENTORY_SQL.read_text())))

        h.REPORT = EVIDENCE / f"{evidence_prefix}-types-bootstrap.json"
        argv = sys.argv
        try:
            sys.argv = [argv[0]]
            if h.main(after_reset=after_reset) != 0:
                h.fail("type generation fixture failed; see sanitized bootstrap evidence")
        finally:
            sys.argv = argv
        if len(outputs) != 2 or outputs[0] != outputs[1] or inventories[0] != inventories[1]:
            h.fail("types or schema/grants inventory differ across the two real resets")
        (EVIDENCE / f"{evidence_prefix}-schema-inventory.json").write_text(json.dumps(inventories[0], indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        finish_artifact(outputs[0], mode)
        report.update(status="passed", generations=2, outputs_equal=True, inventory_equal=True,
                      generator_image=META_IMAGE, generator_image_id=image_id,
                      types_sha256=hashlib.sha256(outputs[0].encode()).hexdigest(),
                      generator_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                      fixture_sha256=hashlib.sha256((ROOT / "scripts/test-db-bootstrap.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest())
    except (RuntimeError, OSError, ValueError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
        report["error"] = str(error) if isinstance(error, RuntimeError) else type(error).__name__
    finally:
        report["artifact_unchanged"] = hashlib.sha256(DESTINATION.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == original_hash
        (EVIDENCE / f"{evidence_prefix}-types-{mode[2:]}.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(report))
    return 0 if report["status"] == "passed" else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""MP-06.c.5 SQL-role, active-profile and containment tests on owned local fixtures."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("bootstrap", ROOT / "scripts/test-db-bootstrap.py")
h = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(h)
SUITES = (
    ('maintenance.sql', ('consume_rate_limit(text,integer,integer)', 'prune_rate_limits()', 'prune_personal_data(integer)'), 'forbidden maintenance invocation succeeded', 18),
    ('read-rpcs.sql', ('lookup_order(text,text)', 'drop_remaining(uuid)', 'settings_effective()'), 'forbidden read RPC invocation succeeded', 18),
    ('order-inserts.sql', ('orders', 'order_items'), 'forbidden order insert succeeded', 12),
    ('audit-writes.sql', ('audit_staff_insert',), 'forbidden audit mutation succeeded: active_owner / insert', 30),
    ('table-truncate.sql', ('settings_truncate',), 'forbidden truncate succeeded: anon / settings', 44),
    ('settings.sql', ('settings_staff_read',), 'settings visibility differs: active_helper', 40),
    ('profiles.sql', ('current_role_name_missing_active_filter',), 'profile authority differs: inactive_owner_forged_service', 17),
)
REPORT = ROOT / "docs/state/evidence/MP-06c5-security.json"
EMPTY_FIXTURES = 'select ' + ' and '.join(
    'not exists(select 1 from public.' + table + ')'
    for table in ('orders', 'order_items', 'products', 'drops', 'settings', 'rate_limits', 'profiles', 'audit_log', 'ledger_entries', 'event_sales', 'event_sale_items')) + ' and not exists(select 1 from auth.users);'


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 1:
        h.fail("security fixture accepts no URLs, project refs or arguments")
    report = {"status": "failed", "scope": "Direct audit mutations, API-role TRUNCATE, private-settings CRUD, active-profile SQL/RLS and six RPC/two insert restrictions; not JWT/API/full MP-06 acceptance", "runs": [], "regressions_detected": [], "upgrade_runs": 0}

    def check(db_id, workdir, password, fixture_report):
        def assert_empty():
            # Every call opens a fresh connection, independent of the test transaction.
            if h.psql(db_id, workdir, EMPTY_FIXTURES).strip() != 't':
                h.fail('security fixture tables are not empty after rollback or before tests')
        assert_empty()
        upgrade = (ROOT / 'tests/integration/security/profile-upgrade.sql').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        migration = (ROOT / 'supabase/migrations/20260101001100_active_profile_authority.sql').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        if h.psql(db_id, workdir, upgrade.replace('__ACTIVE_MIGRATION__', migration)).splitlines().count('UPGRADE|passed') != 1:
            h.fail('populated profile upgrade proof missing')
        assert_empty()
        report['upgrade_runs'] += 1
        results = []
        for filename, signatures, forbidden, expected in SUITES:
            sql = (ROOT / 'tests/integration/security' / filename).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
            for signature in signatures:
                # Failed psql closes the connection and rolls back synthetic grant/data.
                table_test = filename == 'order-inserts.sql'
                grant = 'grant insert on table public.' if table_test else 'grant execute on function public.'
                operation = signature + '_insert' if table_test else signature.split('(')[0]
                broken = sql.replace('begin;', 'begin;\n' + grant + signature + ' to anon;', 1)
                expected_error = forbidden + ': anon / ' + operation
                if filename == 'profiles.sql':
                    # Restore only the missing active filter, within the failing transaction.
                    unsafe = "create or replace function public.current_role_name() returns public.app_role language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$ select p.role from public.profiles p where p.id=auth.uid() $$;"
                    broken = sql.replace('begin;', 'begin;\n' + unsafe, 1)
                    expected_error = forbidden
                if filename == 'settings.sql':
                    unsafe = 'create policy "settings staff read" on public.settings for select using (public.is_staff());'
                    broken = sql.replace('begin;', 'begin;\n' + unsafe, 1)
                    expected_error = forbidden
                if filename == 'table-truncate.sql':
                    broken = sql.replace('begin;', 'begin;\ngrant truncate on public.settings to anon;', 1)
                    expected_error = forbidden
                if filename == 'audit-writes.sql':
                    unsafe = 'grant insert on public.audit_log to authenticated; create policy "audit staff insert" on public.audit_log for insert with check (public.is_staff());'
                    broken = sql.replace('begin;', 'begin;\n' + unsafe, 1)
                    expected_error = forbidden
                try:
                    h.psql(db_id, workdir, broken)
                except RuntimeError as error:
                    if expected_error not in str(error):
                        raise
                    report['regressions_detected'].append(signature)
                else:
                    h.fail('role suite failed to detect a deliberately restored unsafe grant')
                assert_empty()
            output = h.psql(db_id, workdir, sql)
            rows = [line for line in output.splitlines() if line.startswith('SEC_RESULT|')]
            if len(rows) != expected or len(set(rows)) != expected:
                h.fail(filename + ' did not return its complete role matrix')
            results.extend(rows)
            assert_empty()
        if len(set(results)) != 179:
            h.fail('combined role matrix has missing or duplicate cases')
        h.catalog(db_id, workdir, h.sql_for(h.expected_versions()))
        report["runs"].append(sorted(results))

    h.REPORT = ROOT / "docs/state/evidence/MP-06c5-bootstrap.json"
    # Replace an older pass before bootstrap preflight can fail.
    REPORT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    try:
        code = h.main(after_reset=check)
        if code == 0 and len(report["runs"]) == 2 and report["runs"][0] == report["runs"][1] and len(report['regressions_detected']) == 24 and report['upgrade_runs'] == 2:
            report.update(status="passed", cases_per_reset=179, resets=2, matrix_equal=True, rollback_verified=True,
                          sql_sha256={name: hashlib.sha256((ROOT / 'tests/integration/security' / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name, _, _, _ in SUITES},
                          harness_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest())
    except (RuntimeError, OSError, ValueError) as error:
        report['error'] = str(error) if isinstance(error, RuntimeError) else type(error).__name__
    finally:
        REPORT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({key: report.get(key) for key in ("status", "cases_per_reset", "resets")}))
    return 0 if report["status"] == "passed" else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

-- Brings the schema in line with what the engine actually holds.
--
-- The first migration was written from the data-model note. Reading the engine's own
-- constants afterwards showed three things missing, each load-bearing for a screen that
-- already exists — so none of this is speculative. The seed in supabase/seed.sql is
-- generated from those constants and will fail without these columns.

-- Inventory is grouped as Ingredients / Packaging on the inventory and grocery screens,
-- and the sheet title changes with it ("Add packaging item" vs "Add ingredient").
alter table inventory_items add column if not exists category text not null default 'Ingredients';
comment on column inventory_items.category is
  'Ingredients or Packaging. Drives the grouping on the inventory and grocery screens.';

-- Where a supplier is, as she reads it: 'Congressional Ave', 'Online - ships in 2 days'.
alter table suppliers add column if not exists place text not null default '';

-- products.kind already holds Permanent or Rotating — the engine's own field. A second
-- `rotation` column was drafted here and removed: two columns holding the same fact is
-- the duplication this migration is meant to be fixing.
comment on column products.kind is
  'Permanent or Rotating, verbatim from the engine''s PRODUCTS. Drives the shop badge.';

-- Shelf life, per item. Drives the use-by warnings on the inventory screen.
alter table inventory_items add column if not exists pack_label text not null default '';

/**
 * The supplier price book.
 *
 * This was missing entirely, and the "best buy" comparison on the suppliers screen is
 * built from it: for one item, every supplier that sells it, the pack it comes in, the
 * current price, the last prices paid, and whether it is her preferred source.
 *
 * previous_cents is an array rather than a history table on purpose — the screen shows
 * "was 395, 410" and nothing needs to query across it.
 */
create table if not exists supplier_prices (
  id             uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  supplier_id    text not null references suppliers on delete cascade,
  item_name      text not null,
  pack_label     text not null,                    -- '1 kg block', '900 g tub'
  price_cents    bigint not null check (price_cents >= 0),
  previous_cents bigint[] not null default '{}',
  last_bought    text not null default '',         -- as she reads it: '2 Aug'
  preferred      boolean not null default false,
  unique (supplier_id, item_name)
);

-- The best-buy query is "cheapest supplier for this item", so the index leads on the name.
create index if not exists supplier_prices_item_idx on supplier_prices (item_name, price_cents);

alter table supplier_prices enable row level security;
create policy "supplier prices staff read" on supplier_prices
  for select using (is_staff());
create policy "supplier prices owner write" on supplier_prices
  for all using (is_owner()) with check (is_owner());

comment on column recipe_ingredients.qty is
  'Exact quantity in the ingredient''s own unit (g, ml, pcs). Never rounded — half a kilo of butter is a real quantity, and rounding here changes a shopping list.';

-- Capacity, server side.
--
-- This must agree with src/lib/rules/capacity.ts exactly, forever. The parity test in
-- tests/unit/capacity-parity.test.ts runs both over the same table of cases and fails CI
-- if they diverge. If you change one, change the other in the same commit — that is the
-- whole reason both are small enough to read.
--
-- drop_remaining() lives in the init migration, which now uses state_reserves_capacity().
-- This migration adds only the parity mirror, so there is one definition of each.


/**
 * The same decision as decideCapacity() in TypeScript. Kept as its own function so the
 * parity test has something to call, rather than asserting against an inlined expression
 * buried in the order insert.
 */
create or replace function capacity_allows(
  p_capacity  integer,
  p_committed integer,
  p_requested integer
)
returns boolean
language sql
immutable
as $$
  select p_requested > 0
     and p_requested <= greatest(0, greatest(0, floor(p_capacity)::integer)
                                    - greatest(0, floor(p_committed)::integer));
$$;

comment on function capacity_allows(integer, integer, integer) is
  'Mirror of decideCapacity() in src/lib/rules/capacity.ts. Change both together; tests/unit/capacity-parity.test.ts enforces it.';

grant execute on function drop_remaining(uuid) to anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function capacity_allows(integer, integer, integer) to anon, authenticated;

-- Retention and erasure.
--
-- Under the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173, Chapter IV, and IRR §34) a customer has a
-- right to erasure or blocking of their personal data, exercisable at no cost. The owner
-- is the personal information controller.
--
-- The important nuance, and the reason this is not a DELETE:
--
--   Erasure removes the data. Blocking restricts it to a purpose that another law
--   requires. BIR record-keeping means a completed sale cannot simply be deleted — the
--   financial record must survive an audit. So the correct response to an erasure request
--   on a paid order is to BLOCK: strip the personal information, keep the money.
--
-- That is what anonymise_customer() does. The order, its items and its ledger entries
-- stay intact and auditable; the name, phone and notes do not.

-- digest() for the request log. First, not last: a plpgsql body is not resolved at
-- creation time, so creating the extension afterwards happens to work and is luck.
create extension if not exists pgcrypto;

-- Who asked, when, and what was done. The NPC expects a controller to be able to show
-- this, and the owner should not have to remember.
create table if not exists erasure_requests (
  id           uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  phone_hash   text not null,               -- never the number itself
  requested_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  actioned_at  timestamptz,
  action       text check (action in ('anonymised', 'deleted', 'refused')),
  -- Why, in the owner's words. Refusals need a reason on the record.
  note         text not null default '',
  orders_affected integer not null default 0
);

alter table erasure_requests enable row level security;
create policy "erasure requests owner only" on erasure_requests
  for all using (is_owner()) with check (is_owner());

/**
 * Blocks a customer's personal data while preserving the financial record.
 *
 * Replaces the name with 'Removed on request', clears the phone and notes, and records
 * what happened. Returns the number of orders affected so the owner can confirm it
 * matched who she meant.
 *
 * Orders that are still live (not yet collected or paid) are DELETED rather than
 * anonymised — there is no tax record to preserve for a box nobody has bought, and an
 * anonymous pending order is just a box nobody can collect.
 */
create or replace function anonymise_customer(p_phone text, p_note text default '')
returns integer
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_norm    text;
  v_blocked integer := 0;
  v_removed integer := 0;
begin
  if not is_owner() then
    raise exception 'only the owner may action an erasure request';
  end if;

  -- Must match normalisePhone() in src/lib/idempotency.ts and lookup_order().
  v_norm := regexp_replace(p_phone, '\D', '', 'g');
  if left(v_norm, 2) = '63' then v_norm := '0' || substr(v_norm, 3); end if;

  -- Live orders: nothing to preserve, remove them.
  with removed as (
    delete from orders
    where regexp_replace(phone, '\D', '', 'g') = v_norm
      -- 'Payment review' is where an order sits before proof of payment arrives. Nothing
      -- has been paid and no tax record exists, so there is nothing to preserve.
      and state = 'Payment review'
      and pay_state = 'unpaid'
    returning 1
  )
  select count(*) into v_removed from removed;

  -- Everything else is a financial record. Block, do not erase.
  with blocked as (
    update orders
       set customer_name = 'Removed on request',
           phone = '',
           notes = ''
     where regexp_replace(phone, '\D', '', 'g') = v_norm
    returning 1
  )
  select count(*) into v_blocked from blocked;

  insert into erasure_requests (phone_hash, actioned_at, action, note, orders_affected)
  values (encode(digest(v_norm, 'sha256'), 'hex'), now(), 'anonymised', p_note, v_blocked + v_removed);

  return v_blocked + v_removed;
end;
$$;

/**
 * Deletes personal data from orders older than the retention period, keeping the money.
 *
 * The engine already carries RETENTION_DAYS and nothing enforced it. This does. Run it
 * from a monthly cron: a customer's phone number has no purpose two years after they
 * collected their cookies, and data you no longer hold cannot leak.
 */
create or replace function prune_personal_data(p_retain_days integer default 730)
returns integer
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_count integer;
begin
  with pruned as (
    update orders
       set customer_name = 'Past customer',
           phone = '',
           notes = ''
     where placed_at < now() - make_interval(days => p_retain_days)
       and phone <> ''
    returning 1
  )
  select count(*) into v_count from pruned;
  return v_count;
end;
$$;

comment on function prune_personal_data(integer) is
  'Enforces RETENTION_DAYS. Anonymises orders past the window; the financial record survives for BIR.';

grant execute on function anonymise_customer(text, text) to authenticated;
grant execute on function prune_personal_data(integer) to service_role;

-- Optimistic concurrency on the tables two people can edit at once.
--
-- Two users is not a distributed system, and it does not need versioning, vector clocks
-- or a merge policy. It needs one thing: a write must fail rather than silently overwrite
-- an edit made since it was read. Last-write-wins is fine for a note; it is not fine when
-- the owner marks an order paid and a helper's stale form marks it unpaid a second later.
--
-- The rule: every update sends the updated_at it read. If the row has moved on, the
-- update affects zero rows and the caller gets a 409 telling it to re-read.

create or replace function touch_updated_at()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
as $$
begin
  new.updated_at := now();
  return new;
end;
$$;

do $$
declare
  t text;
begin
  foreach t in array array['orders', 'order_items', 'inventory_items', 'bake_batches', 'drops']
  loop
    execute format('alter table %I add column if not exists updated_at timestamptz not null default now()', t);
    execute format('drop trigger if exists %I_touch on %I', t, t);
    execute format(
      'create trigger %I_touch before update on %I for each row execute function touch_updated_at()',
      t, t
    );
  end loop;
end;
$$;

/**
 * Guarded update of an order's state.
 *
 * p_seen_at is the updated_at the caller read. If the row has changed since, this returns
 * no row and the handler answers 409 — which is the honest answer, because the caller's
 * decision was made against data that no longer holds.
 *
 * Returning the current row on conflict would be friendlier and wrong: it invites the
 * caller to retry blindly with the same stale decision.
 */
create or replace function update_order_state(
  p_order_id  text,
  p_seen_at   timestamptz,
  p_state     text default null,
  p_pay_state text default null,
  p_pay_ref   text default null
)
returns table (id text, state text, pay_state text, updated_at timestamptz)
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
begin
  if not is_staff() then
    raise exception 'only staff may change an order';
  end if;

  return query
    update orders o
       set state     = coalesce(p_state, o.state),
           pay_state = coalesce(p_pay_state, o.pay_state),
           pay_ref   = coalesce(p_pay_ref, o.pay_ref)
     where o.id = p_order_id
       -- The guard. Millisecond equality is exact here: updated_at is set by the trigger,
       -- never by a client, so the value the caller read is the value in the row.
       and o.updated_at = p_seen_at
    returning o.id, o.state, o.pay_state, o.updated_at;
end;
$$;

comment on function update_order_state(text, timestamptz, text, text, text) is
  'Optimistic concurrency: returns no row if the order changed since p_seen_at. The handler must answer 409, not retry.';

grant execute on function update_order_state(text, timestamptz, text, text, text) to authenticated;

-- Owner-editable settings.
--
-- The engine carries 21 of these in DEFAULT_CFG and the Settings screen edits them. There
-- was nowhere to store any of it. That is fine while the books live in localStorage, and
-- becomes a real loss the moment T-14 removes it: every setting she has ever changed
-- reverts to a default on a new device, silently, including her capacity and her prices.
--
-- One row, keyed by name, rather than one wide row. The engine's config is a flat bag of
-- scalars that grows, and a wide table needs a migration for each new key while an agent
-- is mid-task. The typed columns keep it honest — a value cannot be stored as the wrong
-- kind, which a jsonb blob would happily allow.
--
-- Money is centavos, consistent with everything else. packagingFee 38.44 is stored 3844.

create table if not exists settings (
  key         text primary key,
  int_value   bigint,
  text_value  text,
  -- Centavos. Separate from int_value so a peso value can never be read as a count.
  cents_value bigint,
  updated_at  timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_by  uuid references auth.users,

  -- Exactly one value column may be set. Without this, a key can hold two different
  -- answers and the reader picks whichever it looked at first.
  constraint settings_one_value check (
    (int_value is not null)::int + (text_value is not null)::int + (cents_value is not null)::int <= 1
  )
);

comment on table settings is
  'Mirrors the engine''s DEFAULT_CFG. Read through settings_effective(); it falls back to the engine defaults for any key the owner has never touched.';

alter table settings enable row level security;
-- Staff read: capacity and the order window drive screens a helper sees.
create policy "settings staff read" on settings for select using (is_staff());
-- Only the owner changes them. These are her prices and her capacity.
create policy "settings owner write" on settings for all
  using (is_owner()) with check (is_owner());

-- Every change is auditable: a wrong capacity or price needs to be traceable to a person.
create or replace function settings_touch()
returns trigger language plpgsql as $$
begin
  new.updated_at := now();
  new.updated_by := auth.uid();
  return new;
end;
$$;

drop trigger if exists settings_touch_trg on settings;
create trigger settings_touch_trg before insert or update on settings
  for each row execute function settings_touch();

/**
 * The effective configuration: the owner's overrides, with the engine's defaults for
 * anything she has never changed.
 *
 * Seeding the table with the defaults instead would look simpler and be wrong — you
 * could no longer tell a deliberate choice of 200 from a default of 200, which matters
 * the day a default changes and every business silently keeps the old one.
 */
create or replace function settings_effective()
returns table (key text, int_value bigint, text_value text, cents_value bigint, is_default boolean)
language sql
stable
as $$
  with defaults (key, int_value, text_value, cents_value) as (
    values
      ('capacity', 200, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('taxRate', 3, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('drawerFloat', null::bigint, null::text, 100000),
      ('discountA', 20, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('discountB', 50, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('restHours', 24, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('doughWarnDays', 14, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('groceryBudget', null::bigint, null::text, 600000),
      ('packagingFee', null::bigint, null::text, 3844),
      ('flatBoxPrice', null::bigint, null::text, 86000),
      ('cogsMultiple', 4, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('priceMode', null::bigint, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('openDow', 1, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('openH', 9, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('openM', 0, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('closeDow', 4, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('closeH', 21, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('closeM', 0, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('extendH', 0, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('retention', null::bigint, '1 year', null::bigint),
      ('maxPerOrder', 24, null::text, null::bigint)
  )
  select d.key,
         coalesce(s.int_value,   d.int_value),
         coalesce(s.text_value,  d.text_value),
         coalesce(s.cents_value, d.cents_value),
         s.key is null
    from defaults d
    left join settings s on s.key = d.key;
$$;

grant execute on function settings_effective() to authenticated;

-- Deliberately NOT granted to anon. The shop needs capacity and the order window, which
-- T-11 should expose through a narrow view rather than by opening the whole table —
-- cogsMultiple and groceryBudget are her margins, and no customer needs them.

-- Staff records do not grant authority until explicitly activated by an administrator.
-- Existing role/display-name data is retained; existing profiles become inactive.
alter table public.profiles add column active boolean not null default false;

-- Preserve the existing function identity/grants and dependent policies.
create or replace function public.current_role_name() returns public.app_role
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select p.role from public.profiles as p
  where p.id = auth.uid() and p.active is true
$$;

-- Private cost/configuration values require active owner authority.
-- The existing owner FOR ALL policy retains owner reads and writes.
-- Publish safe operating settings through a separately reviewed projection.
drop policy "settings staff read" on public.settings;

-- Catalog data only. Never dump transaction rows, credentials or managed auth data.
select jsonb_build_object(
  'columns', (select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) order by table_name, ordinal_position)
    from (select table_name, column_name, ordinal_position, data_type, udt_name,
      is_nullable, column_default from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public') c),
  'constraints', (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table', r.relname, 'name', c.conname,
      'type', c.contype, 'definition', pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid)) order by r.relname, c.conname)
    from pg_constraint c join pg_class r on r.oid=c.conrelid
    join pg_namespace n on n.oid=r.relnamespace where n.nspname='public'),
  'indexes', (select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i) order by tablename, indexname)
    from (select tablename, indexname, indexdef from pg_indexes where schemaname='public') i),
  'table_security', (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table', c.relname,
      'owner', pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner), 'rls', c.relrowsecurity, 'force_rls', c.relforcerowsecurity)
      order by c.relname) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
    where n.nspname='public' and c.relkind='r'),
  'policies', (select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) order by tablename, policyname)
    from (select tablename, policyname, permissive, roles, cmd, qual, with_check
      from pg_policies where schemaname='public') p),
  'table_grants', (select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(g) order by table_name, grantee, privilege_type)
    from (select table_name, grantor, grantee, privilege_type, is_grantable
      from information_schema.table_privileges where table_schema='public') g),
  'functions', (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name', p.proname,
      'identity', pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid), 'returns', pg_get_function_result(p.oid),
      'owner', pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner), 'security_definer', p.prosecdef, 'config', p.proconfig,
      'execute_anon', has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),
      'execute_authenticated', has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),
      'execute_service_role', has_function_privilege('service_role',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),
      'acl', coalesce(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))::text)
      order by p.proname, pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid))
    from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public'),
  'enums', (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name', t.typname, 'label', e.enumlabel,
      'sort', e.enumsortorder) order by t.typname, e.enumsortorder)
    from pg_type t join pg_enum e on e.enumtypid=t.oid
    join pg_namespace n on n.oid=t.typnamespace where n.nspname='public'),
  'default_privileges', (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('owner', pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole),
      'object_type', d.defaclobjtype, 'acl', d.defaclacl::text) order by d.defaclrole, d.defaclobjtype)
    from pg_default_acl d where d.defaclnamespace in (0,'public'::regnamespace))
);
